subject.title: Explore Google Photos backup via Takeout or Data Portability API

question: Should gogcli accept a sensitive new backup surface, and if so should its first scope be only downloading user-created Takeout archives from Drive rather than creating exports or adding a new portability service?
rationale: The supported Google API boundary and the repository's desired security and long-running-state posture determine the command model; source inspection cannot safely choose that product contract.

options.title: Approve a narrow Drive-ingestion feasibility path
options.body: Document and prototype only an opt-in downloader for user-configured Takeout archives in Drive, with no export creation and conservative local state handling.

options.title: Accept a broader portability program
options.body: Sponsor a separate design for OAuth verification, supported resources, archive lifecycle, recurring behavior, and a new command group before code is proposed.

options.title: Decline this product area
options.body: Keep Photos support limited to its currently supported APIs and direct users to Google Takeout for complete-library exports.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow Drive-ingestion feasibility path
recommendation.body: Document and prototype only an opt-in downloader for user-configured Takeout archives in Drive, with no export creation and conservative local state handling.

likelyOwner.reason: The project-level choice spans a new Google API surface, sensitive-data policy, and command architecture rather than an established Photos implementation detail.
